# AgenticSE Repository Memory

For memory-related work in this repository, prefer the `agenticse-memory` skill and the `agenticse` CLI before using ad hoc notes or agent-private memory.

Use AgenticSE when a task involves recalling prior debugging lessons, recording reusable engineering knowledge, capturing code topology, ingesting high-signal terminal or IDE events, or consolidating what was learned at the end of a task.

Keep AgenticSE memories concise and repository-scoped. Do not store secrets, credentials, raw transcripts or noisy telemetry.
